entities.summary: Tom Tykwer (b. 1965-05-23, Wuppertal) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Wuppertal and Germany. Known in the fields of germany, composers & musicians, europe.
